Between the Trump administration’s executive orders, lawsuits, and relentless rhetoric, it can feel as though America’s voting systems are under constant threat. Just this week, President Trump said he asked the Justice Department to sue Alaska to block certification of the state’s Senate race if the Republican candidate loses. But beyond these headlines, what’s actually happening to your vote?

This week on America, Actually, Vox’s Astead Herndon sits down with Eliza Sweren-Becker, the deputy director of the Voting Rights and Elections Program at the Brennan Center for Justice, for a reality check on election security. Despite high-profile threats, Donald Trump is currently on a losing streak in court, and election advocates are racking up major wins.

00:00 Is your vote safe this November?
02:38 How serious is the threat to your vote?
05:58 What’s behind claims of noncitizen voting?
10:44 Who could the SAVE Act keep from voting?
12:39 How voting rights laws and gerrymandering shape elections
16:51 Why election results can take days
19:34 How to prepare to vote this November
21:05 Did the pandemic change how we vote?
22:42 Could Congress delay seating election winners?
24:09 How election rhetoric affects trust and what could restore it?
27:42 Takeaways

America, Actually publishes video episodes every Saturday tackling key issues in politics, culture, and the economy. Subscribe to Vox’s YouTube channel to get them. Listen to episodes of America, Actually on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or your favorite app.

Why Does India Need a Caste Census? 

Why is the caste census an important issue in India? Can caste-based data help ensure social justice, improve welfare policies, and make reservation policies more effective? Or could it create new social and political challenges?

In this video, we explore the need for a Caste Census in India, its significance, and its possible implications for governance, reservation, and social equality.

📌 Topics Covered:
- What is a Caste Census?
- Why does India need a Caste Census?
- Caste Census and social justice
- Relationship between caste data and reservation policy
- Benefits and challenges of collecting caste-based data
- Caste Census: Political implications and governance challenges
- Constitutional and administrative dimensions
- Relevance of the Caste Census for UPSC CSE Prelims and Mains

LIVE ECONOMY FOUNDATION MODULE | ORIENTATION SESSION FOR UPSC CSE 2027 & 2028

Welcome to the Economy Foundation Module for UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) preparation!

Are you preparing for UPSC CSE and looking to build a strong foundation in Indian Economy? This Economy Foundation Orientation Session will help you understand the importance of Economy in the Civil Services Examination and how to approach the subject systematically for UPSC Prelims and Mains.

Indian Economy is an important component of General Studies, particularly General Studies Paper III in the UPSC Mains examination. A clear understanding of economic concepts can help aspirants connect static syllabus topics with current economic developments and improve their overall preparation.

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE ECONOMY FOUNDATION MODULE?
✅ Introduction to Indian Economy and its basic concepts  
✅ Understanding the role of Economy in UPSC CSE  
✅ An overview of the Economy syllabus for Prelims and Mains  
✅ How to build conceptual clarity in Economics from the basics  
✅ The importance of NCERT Economics and standard study resources  
✅ Connecting static Economy with Economic Current Affairs  
✅ Understanding important areas such as GDP, inflation, banking, monetary policy and fiscal policy  
✅ An overview of the Indian Budget, taxation and economic reforms  
✅ A structured approach to Economy preparation, revision and practice  
✅ Guidance for building a consistent and effective UPSC study routine  

WHO SHOULD WATCH THIS SESSION?
This session is useful for:
• UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants  
• UPSC CSE 2028 aspirants  
• Beginners starting Indian Economy from scratch  
• Aspirants preparing for UPSC Prelims and Mains  
• Students who want to strengthen their General Studies Paper III preparation  
• Candidates looking for a systematic Economy foundation strategy  

WHY IS INDIAN ECONOMY IMPORTANT FOR UPSC?
Indian Economy requires conceptual understanding, regular revision and the ability to connect economic theory with current affairs. Topics such as economic growth, national income, inflation, banking, monetary policy, fiscal policy, government budgeting, poverty, unemployment and inclusive growth are important areas to understand during UPSC preparation.

A structured foundation can help you approach these topics with greater clarity and prepare more effectively for both Prelims objective questions and Mains analytical questions.

START YOUR UPSC ECONOMY PREPARATION WITH THE RIGHT DIRECTION!
Watch the complete orientation session, understand the approach to the subject and prepare a clear roadmap for your Economy preparation.
==================================
#UPSC #IndianEconomy #UPSCPreparation
